_meta.purpose: Canonical employer profiles for company-level application ranking. priority is an employer/application signal, not a job-fit or role-family score.
source_scope: selected recurring/recent job-output and application-related companies

classification_notes.size: Broad employee-count bands only; intentionally avoids false precision.
classification_notes.sponsor: Conservative heuristic: likely only with reasonable sponsorship history/evidence or a well-established sponsor-friendly employer; unlikely for defense/citizenship/clearance-heavy or known poor-sponsorship cases; otherwise unknown.
classification_notes.priority: Application-ranking signal only. High favors larger/established sponsor-friendly employers and strong mature/growth tech companies; low favors staffing, clearance-heavy/defense, excluded aggregators, and weak sponsorship prospects.
